name: Question 5
worked_solution:
We have a decoupled system. Therefore, the general solution is given by

$$
x(t)={c}_{1}[\begin{aligned}1 \\ 0\end{aligned}]{e}^{-6t}+{c}_{2}[\begin{aligned}0 \\ 1\end{aligned}]{e}^{\sqrt{3}t},\,{c}_{1},{c}_{2}\in R.
$$

Now, we need to find the values of ${c}_{1}$ and ${c}_{2}$ using the initial condition $x(0)=[\begin{aligned}5 \\ -2\end{aligned}].$ Substituting $t=0$ into the general solution gives

$$
\begin{aligned}x(0) & ={c}_{1}[\begin{aligned}1 \\ 0\end{aligned}]+{c}_{2}[\begin{aligned}0 \\ 1\end{aligned}] \\ [\begin{aligned}5 \\ -2\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}{c}_{1} \\ {c}_{2}\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the solution to our initial value problem is given by

$$
\begin{aligned}x(t) & =5\cdot [\begin{aligned}1 \\ 0\end{aligned}]{e}^{-6t}+(-2)\cdot [\begin{aligned}0 \\ 1\end{aligned}]{e}^{\sqrt{3}t} \\  & =[\begin{aligned}5 \\ 0\end{aligned}]{e}^{-6t}+[\begin{aligned}0 \\ -2\end{aligned}]{e}^{\sqrt{3}t}.\end{aligned}
$$
